title: Spectral convergence of hyperbolic surfaces and quantum ergodicity
summary: We extend the notion of Plancherel convergence, introduced in the study of compact quotients of locally compact groups, to finite-area hyperbolic surfaces and establish a quantum ergodicity theorem for Plancherel sequences. We show that the expectation values of integral operators whose kernels are uniformly bounded and have uniformly bounded propagation become asymptotically equidistributed, on average, for eigenvalues in a fixed compact interval.
